rulesTestNames: admits the owner and the inbox duties to the sender view, by id only
owner: Programme read model projector: programWhatsapp settingViewTriggers
read: get by programme id for the programme owner and the inbox duties, communications and guest relations (programAccessViews; coordinators hold both), while not deleted; never listed
write: server only; written from organizerPrograms and organizerSenderConnections
migrationNotes: Replaces the sender reads of listProgramWhatsappThreads (inbox header), getProgramAssistantSettings and listOrganizerMoments (new planned messages) for the Host app (#2306); the callables stay deployed for released Host builds and retire under #2174. organizerActiveConnectionId keeps listOrganizerMoments' choice (the organiser's first active sender), which can differ from a programme's bound number.

Display-safe by construction: the trigger copies the connection id, display number, verified name and status, never provider ids, the secret reference, test evidence or the connecting account. The program-setting-views copy-forward migration creates views for programmes that predate the triggers.
No personal data: the business number and verified name are the organiser's public WhatsApp identity.
